notes: אִם־לֹא here is not read as the *surely* idiom of rule 30, because the ASV spends a separate word on each morpheme (*since … not*), so rule 2 splits them.
The asseverative כִּי after the oath formula has no English of its own and is marked unrepresented; the alternative would fold it into *therefore*, but that word answers to לָכֵן at the verse's head.
חַי־אָנִי takes *As … live* on the predicate adjective, discontinuous around the pronoun, with אָנִי keeping only its *I* (rule 55).
